observations.description: IPsec VPN connection should allow % in FortiClient Connect REG_PASSWD field.
Cannot clear scanunit vdom-stats to reset the statistics on ATP widget.
Editing a policy in the GUI changes the FSSO setting to disable.
On Firewall Policy list, the tooltip for IP Pool shows Port Block Allocation as being exhausted if there are expiring PBAs available to be reallocated.
In Firefox, the GUI cannot load the IPS signature list page if the user clicks View IPS Signatures before the IPS profile page finishes loading. Other browsers do not have this issue.
Log device defaults to empty and cannot be switched on in the GUI after enabling FortiAnalyzer Cloud.
WAD reads ftp over-limit multi-line response incorrectly.
Inadvertent traffic disruption caused by WAD due to deadlock.
Interface emac-vlan feature does not work on SoC4 platform.
ARM-based platforms do not have sensor readings included in SNMP MIBs.

Enabling ssl-mirror-intf on a management port in a firewall policy with flow mode IPS or application control profiles will cause all traffic to be blocked and the FortiGate to go into kernel panic and automatically reboot.
observations.workaround: do not use a management port as an SSL mirror interface.

observations.description: Local FSSO poller is regularly missing logon events.

When a GUI administrator certificate, admin-server-cert, is provisioned via SCEP, the FortiGate does not automatically offer the newly updated certificate to HTTPS clients. FortiOS 7.0.0 and later does not have this issue.
observations.workaround: manually unset admin-server-cert and set it back to the same certificate. config system global unset admin-server-cert end config system global set admin-server-cert <scep_certificate> end
